game.desc: Tomb Raider: Anniversary is an action and platform game for Xbox 360 that takes the very first episode of Lara Croft's adventures and gives it a new lease of life, both in terms of graphics and gameplay. Rediscover Peru, Greece or Egypt, alongside the pretty brunette hired by the firm Natla Technologies, to get her hands on fragments of an ancient relic called the Scion.
